project_type: Monorepo: Next.js 16 web + Electron/Vite desktop + Expo mobile + Express backend
build_system: npm workspaces — each app has its own package.json. Desktop uses Vite 8 + electron-builder. Web uses Next.js 16 turbopack. Mobile uses Expo 57. Backend uses nodemon.
test_framework: No test framework found in any package.json. Verification is build-only: npm run build.
build_command: Desktop: cd bartender-desktop && npm run build | Web: cd <root> && npm run build | Backend: cd backend && npm run start (no compile step, ES modules run directly)
test_command: No automated tests. Verify with: Desktop: npm run build in bartender-desktop/. Web: npm run build in root. Mobile: npx expo export --platform android. Backend: npm run dev and curl endpoints.
verification_instructions: 1. Desktop changes: run `cd bartender-desktop && npm run build` — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors. 2. Web changes: run `npm run build` in root — must exit 0. 3. Backend changes: run `npm run dev` in backend/ — server must start without crash. 4. Mobile: run `npx expo export --platform android` — must exit 0.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Backend runs on port 4000 (from .env). Do NOT restart any running dev server. Use `cd <dir> && npm run build` pattern for verification. TICKET_SECRET env var needed in backend/.env for Task 8.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: Maintain compatibility between backend, web and desktop when changing APIs, auth or Socket.IO events. Do NOT edit generated artifacts (.next/, dist/, dist-electron/, release/).
key_patterns: Backend: ES Modules (import/export), response helpers ok()/badRequest()/created() from utils/response.js, io from server.js for socket events. Desktop: all components are .tsx, hooks in hooks/, services in services/, Tailwind v4 with custom tokens (gold, ivory, muted, bg, surface-3). Web: useRoulette hook already has full SpinPhase machine — DO NOT modify it. Mobile: StyleSheet.create patterns, Animated.Value from react-native, expo-haptics already installed.
directory_structure: bartender-system/ (Next.js root, src/), bartender-system/bartender-desktop/ (Electron app), bartender-system/mobile-client/ (Expo app), bartender-system/backend/ (Express API). .agents/tasks/ for artifacts (NOT in worktree). Key roulette paths: desktop=bartender-desktop/src/modules/roulette/, web=src/components/cliente/roulette/ + src/hooks/, mobile=mobile-client/src/screens/ + mobile-client/src/components/roulette/, backend=backend/src/controllers/roulette*.js + backend/src/routes/roulette.routes.js
